objective: Keep combat information readable without hiding persistent progress or build identity.

contextual.diveLevelXp: revealed at run start, XP gain and level-up, then fades
contextual.currency: revealed on collection and while a wager is active
contextual.roomMap: revealed during room intro and after room clear
contextual.boonStacks: dominant boon plus no more than two attached identities and one hidden-count summary

mobileGuardrails: objective remains visible on narrow screens
room map and boon pips yield first to touch-safe space
health and energy never yield to notifications
humanExitBlockers: Verify hierarchy at 16:9, 16:10, ultrawide and narrow mobile-reference aspect ratios.
Verify XP reveal is noticed by a new player without becoming persistent clutter.
Verify Special state wording remains readable during high-effect combat.
Approve final compact boon-stack presentation after five-second recognition testing.
